passive.name: loyal guard
passive.description: While Moss is within 6 m (600 cm) of Briar, she takes 10% less damage.
passive.notes: Hypothesis kit authored from the concept sheet (characters#31); full mechanics and rank transformations are authoritative in mechanics. Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 geometry.radius = 600 (Moss is modelled as a follower within 6 m of Briar instead of a separate entity.); rank 0 statuses[0].ticks = 30 (the reduction is refreshed every second (30 ticks) while Moss is near, so it drops one second after Moss leaves.); rank 0 companion = "follows Briar within the passive radius" (Moss is not an entity: the kit reads "Moss nearby" as a distance condition, because only fighters whose weapon or kit deploys a carrier receive entities in this pass.); rank 0 statuses: counter 30 ticks; rank 3 geometry.radius = 720 (Moss is modelled as a follower within 6 m of Briar instead of a separate entity.); rank 3 statuses[0].ticks = 30 (the reduction is refreshed every second (30 ticks) while Moss is near, so it drops one second after Moss leaves.); rank 3 companion = "follows Briar within the passive radius" (Moss is not an entity: the kit reads "Moss nearby" as a distance condition, because only fighters whose weapon or kit deploys a carrier receive entities in this pass.); rank 3 effects[0].perApplication = 15 (allies near Moss gain 15 percent stability resistance, the rank 3 value of the fable passive.); rank 3 statuses: counter 30 ticks; rank 5 geometry.radius = 800 (Moss is modelled as a follower within 6 m of Briar instead of a separate entity.); rank 5 statuses[0].ticks = 30 (the reduction is refreshed every second (30 ticks) while Moss is near, so it drops one second after Moss leaves.); rank 5 companion = "follows Briar within the passive radius" (Moss is not an entity: the kit reads "Moss nearby" as a distance condition, because only fighters whose weapon or kit deploys a carrier receive entities in this pass.); rank 5 effects[0].perApplication = 15 (allies near Moss gain 15 percent stability resistance, the rank 3 value of the fable passive.); rank 5 statuses[1].ticks = 45 (a 1.5 second undying window, the length of the roster phase-saves.); rank 5 cooldownTicks = 1800 (once per 60 s (1800 ticks) so it cannot chain across a fight.); rank 5 statuses: counter 30 ticks, undying 45 ticks.

dossier.identity: tracker bastion who guards the path home: her bloodhound moss sniffs out and tags the enemy while a dome of hardlight carries the squad back standing~
dossier.selectionRationale: bastion because the kit is about holding people together rather than killing: a damage-reducing companion aura, a heal dome and tracking that makes the squad's fire land. distinct from aegis's walls and fable's overflow barriers by being a mobile trail-and-return tank. moss is read as a distance condition, not an entity (companion rule F5 names only arachne and corva). hypothesis kit (owner decision 2026-11-07).
dossier.weaponConcept: tracker rifle (long-range tactical tracker rifle with variable-zoom rangefinder optic, signal-beacon tracking module, smart receiver synced with moss, pink plasma capacitor cell and a carbon and graphite reinforced chassis)

lore.backstory: a trail-marshal for a mountain relief convoy who lost nobody on the road in eleven winters, thanks to a bloodhound called moss and a rifle that tags what should not be there. when the convoy was disbanded she kept both and now walks the ruined sectors escorting anyone who is lost home~
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for escorting forty-one unregistered civilians through a corporate quarantine line and for tagging three syndicate patrol drones as lost property.
lore.psychProfile: steady, freckled optimism; treats every fight as a long walk with one rule: nobody gets left behind, and moss gets the last biscuit.
lore.combatQuote: “good trails, safer tomorrows. you are not alone out here, and neither is anyone behind me.”

iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Briar. Theme: bloodhound moss. Subject: a bold bloodhound head above a single chunky hardlight dome arc. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
